findings.problem: Column/value mismatch on a right-aligned cell table. The benchmark identity, unit, and value 80.5 all appear in the document line, and the protocol says reasoning effort max, matching claude-opus-4.7::max. But the document line `SWE-bench Multilingual   84.4   80.5   -   -` contains two numeric cells under column headers that are not shown here (only a single-column header `Claude Opus 4.7` is given), so it cannot be confirmed that 80.5 sits under 'Claude Opus 4.7' rather than under the first numeric column (84.4) or a neighbour. The column line itself hedges ('exactly one matching value'), which is consistent with the value being the second numeric cell rather than the 'Claude Opus 4.7' column. Evidence supplied is insufficient to satisfy check 3; verify by supplying the full multi-column header for page 194.

Column/neighbour mismatch. The header `| Benchmark | Kimi K2.6 | GPT-5.4 (xhigh) | Claude Opus 4.6 (max effort) | Gemini 3.1 Pro (thinking high) | Kimi K2.5 |` has six cells; the document line `| SWE-Bench Verified | 80.2 | - | 80.8 | 80.6 | 76.8 |` has six cells too, but the column line claims the row carries 'all 3 comparison values' while the row visibly contains 5 numeric/placeholder cells (80.2, -, 80.8, 80.6, 76.8). The count of non-own cells is therefore 5, not 3, and with only one '-' placeholder the positional match to 'Kimi K2.6' (cell 2) holds only if the second cell is 80.2; this is consistent, but the reported comparison-value count contradicts the line and undermines the alignment claim. Also the value 80.2 under Kimi K2.6 collides with the protocol's description (thinking-mode K2.6); the stated 'all 3 comparison values' is irreconcilable with the printed row. Recheck alignment against the full header before publication.

Benchmark version vs registry does not match the printed line. The registry entry is `terminal-bench::4.0` — Terminal-Bench (Agentic) — and the document line prints `Terminal-Bench 4.0   56%   42%   52%   37%`, so the name and version agree. However, the value 42% sits in the second numeric cell of a row whose header line (`Fable family models Claude Fable 5/ Mythos 5`) names a *family*, not the model 'Claude Fable 5'. The column line simultaneously claims the row has 'exactly one matching value' and that it matches column 'Fable family models Claude Fable 5/ Mythos 5' by column position on page 167, while the extraction was cited from Section 8.6, p. 171. The page discrepancy (167 vs 171) and the family-level header mean it cannot be confirmed that 42% is Fable 5's own value rather than Mythos 5's or another family member's. Also the source URL is a system card that also appears under a different candidate (d3b8f42de28997bfb0a1, Claude Fable 5.1 / Claude Mythos 5.1), but this candidate is labelled 'Claude Fable 5' — version drift between the printed model name and the source document title.
